observations.title: Leave items in an anvil
observations.player_action: Insert items and close the anvil screen.
observations.outcome: Inputs remain stored and are rendered on the block instead of returning immediately to the player.
conditions: External documentation is not installed-runtime proof; inspect the installed artifact/configuration before relying on defaults or exact compatibility.
observations.review_note: Anvil output and cost depend on native menu/configuration. Successful result extraction is stronger than inventory ownership; confirm the installed operation signal before a quest.
